title: ANI - #WATCH | JPSC-JSSC alleged irregularities | Ranchi, Jharkhand: Studen...
description: A dense daytime crowd moves along a tree-lined road carrying Indian tricolour flags; several participants wear white, and a man in the foreground raises an arm mid-chant beside a police helmet at the frame's edge. The ANI post describes student protesters breaking through the police barricade near the old Assembly building and heading for the new Assembly complex during the 'Vidhan Sabha Gherao' march. Wire-agency footage, not participant footage.

title: ANI - #WATCH | JPSC-JSSC aspirants' protest in Ranchi (Jharkhand) | Even as...
description: Protesters press against a line of police in olive-green riot helmets as water from a cannon sprays over the front rank; tricolour flags wave over the crowd and raised hands are visible through the mist. The ANI post says police used water cannon to disperse the marchers, who danced and continued the 'Vidhan Sabha Gherao' march. Wire-agency footage.

title: ANI - #WATCH | JPSC-JSSC aspirants' protest in Ranchi (Jharkhand) | Police ...
description: Khaki-uniformed police personnel carrying lathis advance down a debris-strewn street as people scatter in different directions. The ANI post describes police resorting to a lathi charge to control the crowd during the 'Vidhan Sabha gherao' march. Wire-agency footage.

title: The Tatva - 🚨Police use water cannons to disperse the protesting students in Ranchi
description: An elevated wide shot of a water-cannon jet arcing over a dense crowd, with massed police in green helmets in the foreground and tricolour flags among the protesters; the footage carries a PTI watermark, so the clip appears to be agency footage reposted by the account. Posted with the caption that police used water cannons to disperse the protesting students in Ranchi.

title: Video by saur_fit
description: A young man in a cap films himself at night at the protest site, speaking to camera with floodlights and a crowd visible behind him; an overlay reads 'Jharkhand Student Protest - Part 2'. The caption dates it to day seven of the Ranchi sit-in. Self-filmed footage posted by an individual who was at the site.

title: Video by india.puls
description: An edited vertical clip with text overlays reading 'Standing strong through the struggle: students speak on the emotional & physical impact', showing close-up footage of distressed protesters; the account's own watermarks appear over the frame. An aggregator-style edit of protest-site footage rather than a raw clip; the date and place of the underlying footage are not identified in the post.

title: Video by motivation_line_
description: An edited clip about Devendra Nath Mahto's hunger strike: a bearded man lies on a cot beneath a green-and-white canopy with a garland nearby, under large text overlays naming Mahto. Posted by an influencer-style account; the scene is consistent with the hunger-strike site at Jaipal Singh Munda Stadium but the location is not independently confirmed.

title: Video by adultsociety
description: A red water-cannon truck sprays a sustained jet over a crowd beneath roadside trees, in an edited vertical post with headline overlays reading 'Jharkhand students dance as police use water cannons during protest'. The caption describes students facing water cannons during the Assembly march and responding by dancing; the specific road is not identified in the post.

title: Video by thenewspinch
description: Students in small groups walk through open green fields toward buildings on the horizon, in vertical footage carrying a News Pinch watermark. The Hindi caption says that with barricading holding on the roads, students reached the Vidhan Sabha through the fields; the route shown is consistent with that account but not independently confirmed.
